name: Ahmedabad Steelcraft Limited
about: Ahmedabad Steelcraft Limited engages in the trading of steel and electrical items in India. The company also offers engineering, procurement and construction services. It offers structural steel items products, such as beams, channels, flats, rounds and plates, engineering tools, machinery, hardware, equipment, and other industrial products. The company also exports its products. Ahmedabad Steelcraft Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Noida, India.
